name: Rapper's Girlfriend: KISS or DISS
original_name: 래퍼 여친 구함 : KISS or DISS
overview:
Korea's most talked-about rappers are taking over the scene—and when it comes to love, they're just as fearless! With one captivating muse at the center, the rappers' raw romantic instincts collide. Welcome to the ultimate raw and provocative psychological dating game!

When the final curtain falls, their truest emotions, more honest than the love itself, will finally be revealed. Can real love spark in just a single night? "KISS or DISS" The game is on.
